hypothesis: Integrating PLE over each value's empirical CDF interval preserves atomic probability mass and improves on midpoint-rank PLE without feature typing or extra learned parameters.
representation: for value x, average each PLE basis function over [P_train(X<x), P_train(X<=x)]; unseen values use their zero-width insertion CDF
capacity_control: midpoint empirical-rank PLE has identical learned parameters and preprocessing scope but collapses each atom interval to its midpoint
method_gate: interval_rank must beat rank_only on validation RMSE in at least 4/6 development cells and have positive mean paired gain
